subject: SunsetCap renewal: blended-rate check & add new embedding route
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Patel <asha@sunsetcap.ai>, Miguel Santos <m.santos@sunsetcap.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SunsetCap post-demo — token volumes & pricing targets (recap + questions)

Hi Asha / Miguel,

Great to speak this morning — thanks for the candid run-through of your roadmap. Quick recap from our side and a couple of follow-ups to get pricing aligned for the renewal/expansion: 

- Current baseline (as you shared): ~40M tokens/month across chat/generation routes.
- Near-term expansion ask: staging a step-up to ~120M tokens/month in Q4, with a 12-month horizon to ~200M tokens/month once the new summarization route ships.
- Primary goal: get a blended unit at or below ~$120 / 1M tokens for the long-run (this is the target your finance team called out).

Questions for you so I can pull together a formal blended proposal and MAP:
1) Can you confirm expected split by route after expansion? Rough percentages for: chat (inference), embeddings, and reranking.
2) Are there any hard budget ceilings for the 12-month term (ranges are fine — e.g., $X–$Y / month)?
3) You mentioned adding an embeddings-only route ("embed-route-v2") that will drive a large portion of volume — when would that land in prod?

I've attached the usage export we pulled and a draft MAP to align next steps. Proposed next steps from Redwood: 1) rough blended rate options based on the splits you confirm; 2) draft step-up schedule with simple blended math; 3) optional early-commit discount if you can commit to a Q4 baseline.

If it's helpful, I can run a few unit-econ scenarios (target $/1M) and send a short table comparing pure step-tier vs blended-step pricing.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai
Phone: (415) 555-0182

Attachments: SunsetCap_USAGE_Q1.csv; Draft-MAP-v2.pdf
From: Asha Patel <asha@sunsetcap.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Miguel Santos <m.santos@sunsetcap.ai>, procurement@sunsetcap.ai
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2027 12:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SunsetCap post-demo — token volumes & pricing targets (recap + questions)

Thanks Rishi — that was helpful. Quick answers inline: 

On Fri, Jun 5, 2027 at 9:12 AM Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai> wrote:
> - Current baseline (as you shared): ~40M tokens/month across chat/generation routes.
> - Near-term expansion ask: staging a step-up to ~120M tokens/month in Q4, with a 12-month horizon to ~200M tokens/month

Correct. Current: 40M (chat-heavy). Post-release of the embed-route-v2 we expect the split to shift roughly to: chat 35%, embeddings 45%, reranking 20%.

Budget: finance gave a stretch target of $18k–$25k/month for the first 6 months of the step-up (they asked me to push for unit economics that hit your ~$120 /1M token target).

Embed-route-v2 timeline: beta mid-August, prod late September.

We can share a short sample of the embedding payload if needed. Procurement (cc'd) will need a short paper on data handling and SLA before we advance docs.

— Asha
Product @ SunsetCap
asha@sunsetcap.ai

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Patel <asha@sunsetcap.ai>, Miguel Santos <m.santos@sunsetcap.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SunsetCap post-demo — token volumes & pricing targets (recap + questions)

Thanks Asha — this is perfect and matches what we discussed. 

Based on the split (35/45/20) and the volume ramp you outlined, attached is a quick sketch of two approaches (see Cost-Proj-2027.xlsx):

Option A — Step-tier (simple):
- 0–50M: $180 / 1M
- 50–150M: $140 / 1M
- 150–500M: $110 / 1M
Estimated blended at 120M: ~$145 / 1M

Option B — Blended commitment (preferred for predictable billing):
- 12-month committed volume + small overage band; effective blended target can be driven to ~$120 / 1M with a staged step-up and a 10–12% early-commit credit.

We can also separate embedding route pricing (embed-route-v2) since embeddings are lower-cost per token — treating embeddings at a $95–$110 / 1M band reduces the blended effective rate. With your projected split that pushes our modeled blended to ~$125 bearish and ~$115 optimistic depending on early-commit.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Rishi: I’ll send a blended proposal + MAP with explicit month-by-month step-up and blended math (by Mon EOD).
2) SunsetCap: confirm whether the embed-route-v2 will be included in the committed volume or billed separately.
3) Procurement: Laura (cc) will follow up with redline timeframe and standard SOW templates if we get LOI/commit.

If you want, we can show a 3-scenario table (pessimistic / expected / optimistic) with the effective $/1M at each. Will include the HubSpot deal link in the MAP.

-Rishi

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Asha Patel <asha@sunsetcap.ai>, Miguel Santos <m.santos@sunsetcap.ai>
Date: Sat, 06 Jun 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SunsetCap post-demo — pricing options (internal note + suggested concession)

Internal note to Rishi / Ben (cc'd the customer for transparency):

- If SunsetCap's finance is targeting $18k–$25k/month, that maps roughly to the blended target Rishi is modeling if the embedding share is treated preferentially.
- Suggested concession for renewal/expansion: 8% commit credit for a 12-month commitment at >=120M avg/month; additional 5% uplift if they commit to a 24-month term.
- Call out: we should keep the embed-route as a separate line item in the contract to avoid complexity during the first 3 months of launch (bill embed-route either as part of committed volume or as a pass-through with a lower $/1M).

I attached a draft MAP and a quick ppt note we can share with procurement. Also adding Deal ID SD-2027-0039 to the documents for tracking.

Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Operations — Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: Draft-MAP-v2.pdf; Cost-Proj-2027.xlsx

Appreciate the clear options. Quick confirmations: 
- Procurement wants the embedding route included in the committed volume for simplicity, but will accept a separate appendix that lists the embed pricing if Redwood prefers.
- Finance will review the 12-month vs 24-month concession — I expect we can get a verbal nod for 12-month commit within the week.
- Can you include a sample SLA clause and a short note on data retention/keys for procurement? Procurement listed those as gating items.

If you can send the 3-scenario table and a short one-page SLA excerpt, we can move to a formal LOI.

Miguel Santos
